gripOrHq.title: Antiquated Interface Routines
gripOrHq.rulesText: All ice on this fort has +1 strength.

gripOrHq.title: Fortress Architects
gripOrHq.rulesText: Cost to install ice is reduced by [1].

gripOrHq.title: Braindance Campaign
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Braindance Campaign when you rez it. Take [2] from Braindance Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Braindance Campaign.

gripOrHq.title: Superior Net Barriers
gripOrHq.rulesText: All walls have +1 strength. When you score Superior Net Barriers, reveal as many walls as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed wall.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Playful AI
discardCards.rulesText: Roll a die. On a 1, 2, or 3, gain that many bits, set aside that many dice to roll again, or choose some combination thereof. Repeat until you have rolled all the dice you set aside.

rig.title: Clown
rig.rulesText: All ice is encountered with its strength reduced by 1.

rig.title: Snowball
rig.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

rig.title: Expert Schedule Analyzer
rig.rulesText: After you access cards from HQ, look at all cards stored in HQ.

rig.title: Aujourd’Oui
rig.rulesText: A: Look at the top five cards of your stack. You may bring any program cards among them into your hand. Pay [1] for each card taken in this way, and show those cards to the Corp. Shuffle your stack.

ice.title: Cortical Scanner
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] End the run.
[Subroutine] End the run.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Fortress Architects
root.rulesText: Cost to install ice is reduced by [1].
